title: Transfer of unbounded exchange invertibility from cyclic coefficients
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, n a natural number with n·1_Λ=0, and let g', f', f, g be a cartesian square of schemes as in [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Suppose the canonical exchange of [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] is an isomorphism of functors on D(X_et, Z/nZ). Then, for every K in D(X_et, Λ) of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], its canonical Λ-coefficient exchange is an isomorphism. No properness hypothesis is needed for this coefficient comparison. Universe lifting is used to place both coefficient categories in the same universe.

source.place: Tag 0D6J(3), with the canonical mate coherence stated by lem-kun-unbounded-abelian-exchange-comparison; coefficient restriction from the proof of lem-kun-proper-base-change-torsion-ring

proof.text: The relation n·1_Λ=0 gives the explicit map Z/nZ → Λ, [a] ↦ a·1. Restrict a representing complex termwise with action [a]m=(a·1)m. Restriction preserves kernels and cokernels, hence quasi-isomorphisms, and the restricted complex K_n has exactly the same underlying abelian complex as K. This also works for n=0 with ZMod 0=ℤ.

The assumed cyclic-coefficient exchange is invertible at K_n. Apply lem-kun-unbounded-abelian-exchange-comparison for Z/nZ: t_n U_n(Ex_n)=Ex_ab s_n, with s_n,t_n invertible. It follows that Ex_ab is invertible. Apply the same comparison for Λ; the equality of underlying complexes identifies exactly the same Ex_ab, and t_Λ U_Λ(Ex_Λ)=Ex_ab s_Λ makes U_Λ(Ex_Λ) invertible. The conservative forgetting functor then reflects invertibility of Ex_Λ. These equations concern the canonical mates, not just their endpoints.
